violation_type.title: Care Requirements for Pre-Kindergarten Age - Individual Attention (26 TAC §746.2601(2))
violation_type.short_title: Care Requirements for Pre-Kindergarten Age - Individual Attention
violation_type.typical_finding: The investigation found that a caregiver was redirecting a child and the child tripped, and the caregiver did not console the child afterwards.

finding_variants.text: The investigation found that a caregiver was redirecting a child and the child tripped, and the caregiver did not console the child afterwards.
Based on the information obtained through the DFPS Investigation, there is evidence to show that individual attention was not provided to a pre-k child who was upset.
The caregiver was not providing individualized attention to a child that was upset and crying.
